@@ -0,0 +1,122 @@
+knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
+knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE)
+work.path<- "/Volumes/PromisePegasus/_Research_/R013_SPT6_yeast_clean/figures/Fig3/TES_PolII_profile/"
+knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir =work.path)
+outDir<-paste0(work.path, "/B_correlation_nucReg_vs_RNAPII/")
+dir.create(outDir,recursive = T, showWarnings = F)
+library(tidyverse)
+library(pheatmap)
+library(ggpubr)
+library(reshape2)
+library(LSD)
+library(plyranges)
+#heatmapto read
+heatIN<-"values_Heatmap.txt"
+heatmap<-read.delim(heatIN, skip=1, header = F)
+#extract bed input
+geneList<-heatmap[,1:6]
+colnames(geneList)<-c("chr", "start", "end", "name", "nucPositioning","strand")
+#split samples
+#get head info
+heatmapHEAD<-read.delim(heatIN, nrows=1, header = F)
+#extract info from head
+features<-heatmapHEAD %>% str_split("],")
+#get positions
+binSize<-grep("bin size",features[[1]], value = T) %>% str_split(",") %>%
+unlist() %>%  dplyr::first() %>% str_split_i("\\:\\[",2) %>% as.numeric()
+upstream<-grep("upstream",features[[1]], value = T) %>% str_split(",") %>%
+unlist() %>%  dplyr::first() %>% str_split_i("\\:\\[",2) %>% as.numeric()
+downstream<-grep("downstream",features[[1]], value = T) %>% str_split(",") %>%
+unlist() %>%  dplyr::first() %>% str_split_i("\\:\\[",2) %>% as.numeric()
+ncol_sample<-(upstream+downstream)/binSize
+pos<-seq(c(-1)*(upstream-binSize/2),downstream-binSize/2,binSize)
+samples<-grep("sample_labels",features[[1]], value = T) %>%
+str_split_i("\\:\\[",2) %>% str_split(",") %>% unlist()
+getHeatSamp<-function(name,ncol_sample=ncol_sample, samples=samples,
+heatmapVal=heatmapVal) {
+idx<-which(samples==name)
+idxHeat<-seq(((idx-1)*ncol_sample+1),idx*ncol_sample)
+heat<-heatmapVal[,idxHeat]
+colnames(heat)<-pos
+rownames(heat)<-geneList$name
+return(heat)
+}
+extractHeat<-function(heatIN, samples.select){
+heatmap<-read.delim(heatIN, skip=1, header = F)
+#get heatValues
+heatmapVal<-heatmap[,-(1:6)]
+#get head info
+heatmapHEAD<-read.delim(heatIN, nrows=1, header = F)
+#extract info from head
+features<-heatmapHEAD %>% str_split("],")
+samples.fkt<-grep("sample_labels",features[[1]], value = T) %>%
+str_split_i("\\:\\[",2) %>% str_split(",") %>% unlist()
+for(i in samples.select){
+if(i==samples.select[1]){
+heat.pooled<- getHeatSamp(name=i,ncol_sample=ncol_sample,
+samples=samples.fkt,
+heatmapVal=heatmapVal)
+}else {
+heat.pooled<-heat.pooled + getHeatSamp(name=i,ncol_sample=ncol_sample,
+samples=samples.fkt,
+heatmapVal=heatmapVal)
+}
+}
+return(heat.pooled)
+}
+## convergent genes
+convergent<-read_bed("../../../data/gene_annotation/TES_genenOrientation/TES_regSorted_convergent.bed")
+regScore.conv<-convergent$score
+names(regScore.conv)<-convergent$name
+### tandem
+tandem<-read_bed("../../../data/gene_annotation/TES_genenOrientation/TES_regSorted_tandem.bed")
+regScore.tandem<-tandem$score
+names(regScore.tandem)<-tandem$name
+### isolated
+isolated<-read_bed("../../../data/gene_annotation/TES_genenOrientation/TES_regSorted_lonely.bed")
+regScore.isolated<-isolated$score
+names(regScore.isolated)<-isolated$name
+#get heatmap values
+pool.WT<-extractHeat(heatIN="values_Heatmap.txt",
+samples.select=c("GSM8694296_WT_37C_PolII_ChIP_rep1",
+"GSM8694297_WT_37C_PolII_ChIP_rep2",
+"GSM8694298_WT_37C_PolII_ChIP_rep3"))
+## limit to - 250 - 250 bp of TES
+tes.WT<-apply(
+pool.WT[,which(as.numeric(colnames(pool.WT))>(-250) &
+as.numeric(colnames(pool.WT))<250)],
+1,sum)
+outDir<-paste0(work.path, "/B_correlation_nucReg_vs_RNAPII/Pearson/")
+dir.create(outDir,recursive = T, showWarnings = F)
+getCorPlot<-function(regScore.x,facScore.x, name){
+#make data frame and log2
+df<-data.frame(
+logNucReg=log2(regScore.x),
+logFacOcc=log2(facScore.x[names(regScore.x)])
+) %>%
+filter(logNucReg > 15) %>%
+filter(logFacOcc != (-Inf))
+# linear regression model
+model <- lm(logFacOcc ~ logNucReg, data = df)
+#get cooks distance
+cooks_d <- cooks.distance(model)
+#filter by cooks distance
+df.flt<-df[-which(cooks_d>0.01),]
+#flt.model
+model.flt <- lm(logFacOcc ~ logNucReg, data = df.flt)
+#plot
+pdf(file=paste0(outDir,"/",name,"_heatscatter.pdf"),width=4, height=4)
+heatscatter( df.flt$logNucReg, df.flt$logFacOcc,
+cor = T, xlab = "nucleosome regulartiy score (log2)",
+ylab="factor occupancy (log2)", method="pearson")
+# Add regression line
+abline(model.flt, col = "black", lwd = 2, lty=2)
+dev.off()
+}
+## WT
+getCorPlot(regScore.x=regScore.conv,facScore.x=tes.WT,
+name="WT_both_convergent")
+getCorPlot(regScore.x=regScore.tandem,facScore.x=tes.WT,
+name="WT_both_tandem")
+getCorPlot(regScore.x=regScore.isolated,facScore.x=tes.WT,
+name="WT_both_isolated")
